helper_evidence.finding: lease_epoch alone is not exact logical execution identity; same epoch can alias different execution_id candidates unless exact V16 execution/admission identity is bound.

restoring an older valid SQLite snapshot reproduced old-capability resurrection; DB-local epoch can move backwards while SQLite integrity remains valid. A non-rollback restore/incarnation generation or equivalent invalidation is required before material readiness.

architecture_refinement.old_v11_assumption: HHandle freshness bound semantic root + state epoch + execution generation + delivery generation in one object.
architecture_refinement.new_v12_rule: Split canonical semantic identity from delivery lineage. HCanonicalHandle binds semantic root + state epoch + non-rollback restore incarnation + schema. HDeliveryUse separately binds exact request/execution/admission/session/client/delivery lineage. Effect authority remains a third independent fence.
architecture_refinement.reason: This prevents stale delivery and snapshot resurrection without needlessly invalidating immutable semantic content merely because a new execution legitimately references it.

new_counterhypotheses: Production recovery may already provide an equivalent non-rollback invalidation mechanism, making explicit restore_incarnation redundant.
Per-handle delivery lineage may be overbinding; response-envelope-level lineage may achieve zero stale-splice failures at lower cost.
